name: Silverspine Stud
text:
This silver tongue piercing resembles a long, curved spine from a paper spine cactus and makes your quips just as prickly. While wearing the stud, you gain a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to Bon Mot and to Performance checks while acting, orating, or performing comedy.

Activate—Prickly Challenge 2 (concentrate, linguistic, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You issue an enchanting verse that compels your target to respond in kind. The target is affected by curse of verse (DC 28). If the target fails its saving throw, it is Slowed 1 for 1 round as it spends an action responding with its own verse.
